# `aitbc bond suspend`

Suspend a provider's bond eligibility without moving funds (admin only). Local eligibility flag only: the bond's stored status is untouched, the automatic slasher still applies, and no funds move. Only a matching accepted slash appeal (``bond appeal`` then ``bond resolve-appeal``) lifts the suspension. Rebinding cannot bypass a live suspension while the original bond remains active; once it reconciles to a terminal state a genuinely new verified lock may replace it — that never resolves or reactivates the old bond.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc bond suspend [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider-id` | text | — | yes | Provider ID. |
| `--bond-id` | text | — | yes | On-chain bond id to suspend (must match the bound bond). |
| `--reason` | text | — | yes | Suspension reason recorded for governance review. |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc bond suspend --provider-id <provider_id> --bond-id <bond_id> --reason <reason>
```
